237-In the "Workflow permissions" section, you can set the **default** permissions granted to the `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
238-
239:* **Read and write permissions:** The default permissions for the `GITHUB_TOKEN` depend on when the enterprise or organization was created:
240-
241-  * **Created on or after February 2, 2023** – Defaults to **read-only** access for all scopes.
242-  * **Created before February 2, 2023** – Defaults to **read and write** access for all scopes.
243-
244-* **Read repository contents and packages permissions:** By default, `GITHUB_TOKEN` has only read access for the `contents` and `packages` scopes. The more permissive setting cannot be chosen as the default for individual organizations or repositories.

item.text: {"answer":"You cannot make “Read and write” the default at the organization/repository level if the enterprise/org policy is set to the more restrictive default. GitHub Docs says the default permissions can be configured in organization settings, but if the org has a more restrictive default, that option is selected in the repository settings and the permissive option is disabled. For enterprise/org defaults, the docs also say the more permissive setting cannot be chosen as the default for individual organizations or repositories.
